name: DJ FSKØ
description: DJ FSKØ plays a late-night party at Zero Box Lodge, mixing baile funk, global sounds, and jersey club.
longDescription:
DJ FSKØ takes over the decks at Zero Box Lodge on 14 November 2026. The night features a mix of baile funk, global sounds, and jersey club, running from 23:00 until 02:00.

The party takes place at Rua do Ateneu Comercial do Porto, 13. Admission is free.
descriptionPt: O DJ FSKØ comanda a noite no Zero Box Lodge, misturando baile funk, sonoridades globais e jersey club.
longDescriptionPt:
O DJ FSKØ assume os comandos da cabine no Zero Box Lodge a 14 de novembro de 2026. A noite combina baile funk, sonoridades globais e jersey club, com a música a tocar entre as 23:00 e as 02:00.

A festa acontece na Rua do Ateneu Comercial do Porto, 13. A entrada é gratuita.
